1	"""Tests for the drag-to-connect wiring flow on the canvas.
2	
3	Regression coverage for the bug where the in-progress "rubber" wire was
4	returned by ``itemAt`` in ``mouseReleaseEvent`` and silently swallowed the
5	click on the destination port, so blocks never connected.
6	
7	PyQt6 forbids direct instantiation of ``QGraphicsSceneMouseEvent``, so we
8	exercise the same call path that ``mousePressEvent`` / ``mouseReleaseEvent``
9	use internally: ``_start_wire`` → ``_port_at`` → ``connect_ports``.
10	"""
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	import pytest
13	from PyQt6.QtCore import QEvent, QPointF, QLineF, Qt
14	from PyQt6.QtGui import QMouseEvent
15	from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication
16	
17	from silmulator.gui.canvas import CanvasScene, CanvasView, WireItem
18	
19	
20	def _simulate_drag(scene: CanvasScene, src_port, target_pos: QPointF):
21	    """Mirror what mousePress/Move/Release do, end-to-end."""
22	    scene._start_wire(src_port, src_port.scenePos())
23	    scene._temp_wire.setLine(QLineF(src_port.scenePos(), target_pos))
24	    target = scene._port_at(target_pos)
25	    wire = None
26	    if target is not None and target is not scene._connecting:
27	        wire = scene.connect_ports(scene._connecting, target)
28	    scene._cancel_wire()
29	    return wire
30	
31	
32	@pytest.fixture
33	def scene(qapp):
34	    return CanvasScene()
35

37	def test_port_at_skips_in_progress_temp_wire(scene):
38	    """The original bug: temp wire (zValue=100) shadowed the destination
39	    port, so itemAt returned the wire and the connection silently failed."""
40	    osc = scene.add_block("Oscilloscope", QPointF(0, 0))
41	    psu = scene.add_block("Power Supply", QPointF(500, 0))
42	    src, dst = osc.ports[0], psu.ports[0]
43	
44	    scene._start_wire(src, src.scenePos())
45	    scene._temp_wire.setLine(QLineF(src.scenePos(), dst.scenePos()))
46	
47	    found = scene._port_at(dst.scenePos())
48	    assert found is dst, "temp wire should not shadow the destination port"
49	
50	    scene._cancel_wire()
51

113	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
114	# End-to-end drag through the real QGraphicsView event path.
115	#
116	# Regression coverage for the bug where CanvasScene's mouse handlers never
117	# accepted the events: the view (RubberBandDrag mode) treated the unaccepted
118	# press as the start of a rubber-band selection that drew over the wire drag
119	# and replaced the scene selection on every move.
120	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
121	
122	
123	def _send_mouse(view: CanvasView, etype: QEvent.Type, scene_pos: QPointF,
124	                button: Qt.MouseButton, buttons: Qt.MouseButton) -> None:
125	    """Deliver a synthetic mouse event to the view's viewport, the same way
126	    a real click arrives (view → scene), in viewport coordinates."""
127	    viewport = view.viewport()
128	    view_pt = view.mapFromScene(scene_pos)
129	    event = QMouseEvent(
130	        etype, QPointF(view_pt), QPointF(viewport.mapToGlobal(view_pt)),
131	        button, buttons, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier,
132	    )
133	    QApplication.sendEvent(viewport, event)
134	
135	
136	def test_real_mouse_drag_connects_ports_without_rubber_band(scene):
137	    """Press → move → release through the view must create the wire and must
138	    NOT start a rubber-band selection over the drag."""
139	    view = CanvasView(scene)
140	    view.resize(1200, 600)
141	    view.show()
142	
143	    osc = scene.add_block("Oscilloscope", QPointF(0, 0))
144	    psu = scene.add_block("Power Supply", QPointF(500, 0))
145	    src, dst = osc.ports[0], psu.ports[0]
146	    view.centerOn(QPointF(350, 100))
147	
148	    _send_mouse(view, QEvent.Type.MouseButtonPress, src.scenePos(),
149	                Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton)
150	    midpoint = (src.scenePos() + dst.scenePos()) / 2
151	    _send_mouse(view, QEvent.Type.MouseMove, midpoint,
152	                Qt.MouseButton.NoButton, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton)
153	    _send_mouse(view, QEvent.Type.MouseMove, dst.scenePos(),
154	                Qt.MouseButton.NoButton, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton)
155	
156	    assert view.rubberBandRect().isNull(), (
157	        "view started a rubber-band selection during the wire drag — "
158	        "the scene did not accept the mouse press"
159	    )
160	
161	    _send_mouse(view, QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease, dst.scenePos(),
162	                Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton, Qt.MouseButton.NoButton)
163	
164	    assert src.connected_to is dst
165	    assert dst.connected_to is src
166	    assert any(isinstance(i, WireItem) for i in scene.items())
167	    assert scene.selectedItems() == [], (
168	        "a wire drag must not select blocks via rubber-band"
169	    )
170	    view.close()

25	
26	    assert isinstance(block, BaseBlock)
27	    assert block.block_id and len(block.block_id) >= 4
28	    # device_type must round-trip through to_dict()/from_dict(): it is the
29	    # registry lookup key, so any mismatch silently drops the block (and all
30	    # of its wires) when a saved layout is reopened.
31	    assert block.device_type == device_type

38	    block = scene.add_block(device_type, QPointF(0, 0))

49	def _block_rect(block: BaseBlock):
50	    """Scene-space rectangle occupied by a block."""
51	    return (block.x(), block.y(),
52	            block.x() + block.BLOCK_WIDTH, block.y() + block.BLOCK_HEIGHT)

55	def _rects_overlap(a, b) -> bool:
56	    return not (a[2] <= b[0] or b[2] <= a[0] or a[3] <= b[1] or b[3] <= a[1])

60	    """Blocks added without an explicit position (toolbar / menu / library
61	    panel) must never stack on top of each other — overlapping blocks hide
62	    the first block's ports and any wires between them."""
63	    types = ["Oscilloscope", "Power Supply", "Function Generator",
64	             "Multimeter", "MSP430", "Code Input"]

66	    assert all(b is not None for b in blocks)

68	class BaseBlock(QGraphicsItem):
69	    """Abstract base for all hardware blocks.
70	
71	    Provides:
72	    - Drag-and-drop movement
73	    - Title bar with device type and name
74	    - Connection ports
75	    - Right-click context menu
76	    - SCPI command routing to the underlying device
77	    """
78	
79	    BLOCK_WIDTH = 220
80	    BLOCK_HEIGHT = 160
81	    TITLE_HEIGHT = 30
82	    HEADER_COLOR = QColor(60, 80, 120)
83	    BODY_COLOR = QColor(240, 245, 255)
84	    BORDER_COLOR = QColor(30, 50, 90)
85	    SELECTED_COLOR = QColor(255, 160, 0)
86	
87	    def __init__(self, device: BaseDevice, device_type: str, parent=None) -> None:
88	        super().__init__(parent)
89	        self.device = device
90	        self.device_type = device_type
91	        self.block_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
92	        self.name = f"{device_type}-{self.block_id}"
93	        self._ports: List[ConnectionPort] = []
94	        self._command_log: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
95	
96	        self.setFlag(QGraphicsItem.GraphicsItemFlag.ItemIsMovable, True)
97	        self.setFlag(QGraphicsItem.GraphicsItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable, True)
98	        self.setFlag(QGraphicsItem.GraphicsItemFlag.ItemSendsGeometryChanges, True)
99	        self.setAcceptHoverEvents(True)
100	        self.setCacheMode(QGraphicsItem.CacheMode.DeviceCoordinateCache)
101	
102	        # Shadow effect
103	        shadow = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect()
104	        shadow.setBlurRadius(15)
105	        shadow.setOffset(4, 4)

108	
109	        self._setup_ports()
110	        self._setup_ui()
111	
112	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
113	    # Geometry
114	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
115	
116	    def boundingRect(self) -> QRectF:
117	        return QRectF(0, 0, self.BLOCK_WIDTH, self.BLOCK_HEIGHT)
118	
119	    def shape(self) -> QPainterPath:
120	        path = QPainterPath()
121	        path.addRoundedRect(self.boundingRect(), 8, 8)
122	        return path
123	
124	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
125	    # Painting
126	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
127	
128	    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option, widget=None) -> None:
129	        rect = self.boundingRect()
130	
131	        # Body gradient
132	        gradient = QLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, rect.height())
133	        gradient.setColorAt(0.0, self.BODY_COLOR)
134	        gradient.setColorAt(1.0, self.BODY_COLOR.darker(110))
135	        painter.setBrush(QBrush(gradient))
136	
137	        # Border (highlighted when selected)
138	        border_color = self.SELECTED_COLOR if self.isSelected() else self.BORDER_COLOR
139	        painter.setPen(QPen(border_color, 2.0 if self.isSelected() else 1.5))
140	        painter.drawRoundedRect(rect, 8, 8)
141	
142	        # Title bar
143	        title_rect = QRectF(0, 0, rect.width(), self.TITLE_HEIGHT)
144	        header_gradient = QLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, self.TITLE_HEIGHT)
145	        header_gradient.setColorAt(0, self.HEADER_COLOR.lighter(120))
146	        header_gradient.setColorAt(1, self.HEADER_COLOR)
147	        painter.setBrush(QBrush(header_gradient))
148	        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
149	        path = QPainterPath()
150	        path.addRoundedRect(title_rect, 8, 8)
151	        # Square off bottom corners
152	        path.addRect(QRectF(0, self.TITLE_HEIGHT / 2, rect.width(), self.TITLE_HEIGHT / 2))
153	        painter.drawPath(path)
154	
155	        # Title text
156	        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255)))
157	        font = QFont("Consolas", 9, QFont.Weight.Bold)
158	        painter.setFont(font)
159	        painter.drawText(
160	            QRectF(8, 0, rect.width() - 16, self.TITLE_HEIGHT),
161	            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft,
162	            f"{self.device_type}"
163	        )
164	
165	        # Block name (smaller)
166	        font.setPointSize(7)
167	        font.setBold(False)
168	        painter.setFont(font)
169	        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(200, 230, 255)))
170	        painter.drawText(
171	            QRectF(rect.width() - 70, 0, 60, self.TITLE_HEIGHT),
172	            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight,
173	            self.block_id
174	        )
175	
176	        # Draw device-specific content
177	        self._paint_content(painter, rect)
178	
179	    def _paint_content(self, painter: QPainter, rect: QRectF) -> None:
180	        """Subclasses override to draw device-specific content."""

190	        port = ConnectionPort(self, port_id, label)
191	        port.setPos(self.BLOCK_WIDTH * x_frac, self.BLOCK_HEIGHT * y_frac)
192	        self._ports.append(port)

195	    @property
196	    def ports(self) -> List[ConnectionPort]:
197	        return self._ports

201	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
202	
203	    def send_command(self, cmd: str) -> str:
204	        response = self.device.process(cmd)
205	        self._command_log.append((cmd, response))
206	        if len(self._command_log) > 500:
207	            self._command_log = self._command_log[-500:]
208	        self.update()
209	        return response
210	
211	    @property
212	    def command_log(self) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
213	        return list(self._command_log)
214

243	        from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QTextEdit, QVBoxLayout, QPushButton
244	        dlg = QDialog()
245	        dlg.setWindowTitle(f"Command Log — {self.name}")
